title: Among molecules that contain both sulfur and phosphorus atoms connected via
question: Among molecules that contain both sulfur and phosphorus atoms connected via double bonds, which carcinogenic label ('+' or '-') is more common?

prediction.sql:
SELECT m."XCL_011" AS carcinogenic_label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON m."XCL_010" = a1."XCL_002"
JOIN atom a2 ON m."XCL_010" = a2."XCL_002"
JOIN connected c1 ON a1."XCL_001" = c1."XCL_007"
JOIN connected c2 ON a2."XCL_001" = c2."XCL_007"
JOIN bond b ON c1."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004" AND c2."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
WHERE a1."XCL_003" = 's'
  AND a2."XCL_003" = 'p'
  AND b."XCL_006" = '='
GROUP BY m."XCL_011"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT m."XCL_011" AS carcinogenic_label, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON m."XCL_010" = a1."XCL_002"
JOIN atom a2 ON m."XCL_010" = a2."XCL_002"
JOIN bond b ON m."XCL_010" = b."XCL_005"
JOIN connected c1 ON a1."XCL_001" = c1."XCL_007"
JOIN connected c2 ON a2."XCL_001" = c2."XCL_008"
WHERE a1."XCL_003" = 's'
  AND a2."XCL_003" = 'p'
  AND b."XCL_006" = '='
  AND c1."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
  AND c2."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
GROUP BY m."XCL_011"
ORDER BY cnt DESC
